car.name: Foxmint 1.7 2000
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 mint and burgundy compact three-door coupe. UK September 2000 standard 1.7 VCT five-speed RHD inspiration, not Racing or Black editions. OEM full-fluid lightest kerb weight and workshop date coverage disclosed.

catalogProvenance.inspiration: UK September 2000 Ford Puma standard 1.7i 16V VCT coupe, FWD five-speed manual, RHD; not Racing Puma, Puma Black, 1.4/1.6 or modern Puma SUV

sources.kind: OEM UK sales brochure hosted by independent archive
fields: Actual pages 14, 15 and 20 rendered and visually inspected. Final page identifies Ford Motor Company Limited, FA1260/14, 09.2000. Archive filename 2001 does not override actual September 2000 publication date.

sources.kind: OEM workshop material mirrored as HTML, coverage June 1997–December 2001
fields: Read engine table; corroborates brochure output and displacement. No exact serial-number breakpoint independently checked.

fields: Read 1.7-specific ratio column, not 1.4 column. Published precision is two decimal places; do not invent tooth-exact extra digits.

estimates: Actual OEM UK brochure pages 14, 15 and 20 visually inspected; dated 09.2000 despite archive filename 2001. Standard 1.7 VCT RHD three-door coupe, not Racing Puma or Puma Black.

92 kW converted to mechanical hp; 125 PS is NOT 125 mechanical hp. 157 Nm converted to lb-ft. 1038 kg is lightest kerb weight with full fluid levels and option/tolerance qualification; driver convention unspecified. No 75 kg adjustment or substitution of 1109 kg.

Physical five-speed and final ratios from the 1.7-specific OEM workshop HTML mirror covering June 1997 to December 2001, published to two decimals. Exact serial breakpoint, tooth counts and finer precision are unverified. Standard 195/50R15 nominal radius .288m; loaded rolling radius unknown.

6500 redline, 6800 cutoff, 800 idle, front mass fraction .60, 1.445m front/rear tracks, differential 0/0, CG .52m, .14m clearance, overhang split, Cd .32, steering 16, 30 US mpg, 9.0 second 0-60 display, full torque curve and normalized handling/brake/shift/launch parameters are simulation estimates. OEM 9.2 seconds is 0-100 km/h, not 0-60 mph. Published top speed 203 km/h converted to mph. No LSD or exact ABS/traction calibration asserted.
Original individually authored RIGHT HAND DRIVE dashboard; shared wheel and upper-opening instruments anchored to right binnacle. Fixed rear camera and surface tire smoke/spray only.
